newsitem.title: USA: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA wheat export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 422,900 metric tons (MT) were off 28 percent from the previous week, but 59 percent above the 4-week average.

The major increases were for unknown destinations (55,100 MT), Israel (46,400 MT), Venezuela (40,200 MT), Mexico (35,400 MT), and Egypt (35,000 MT). Exports of 285,200 MT were 17 percent below the prior week, but up 2 percent from the 4-week average. The primary destinations were the Philippines (76,600 MT), Japan (41,200 MT), Mexico (32,300 MT), and Pakistan (31,500 MT).
